title: Absolutely incredible...
text: Absolutely incredible experience to walk into La Sagrada Família and see such intense colors throughout the cathedral. Highly recommended!
author: Dave_B

title: Our guide gave us great...
text: Our guide gave us great details about the church and made sure to show them to us.   The time inside the church was filled with beautiful reflections for the sunlight as our guide moved us within it.   Try to visit on a sunny day to get the full effect of the beauty of the all the colors that can be seen.
author: Gary_L

title: Amazing tour!
text: David was an amazing tour guide, very knowledgeable and personable.  We enjoyed every moment and are looking forward to returning to experience Sagrada Família at dusk!
author: Leslie

title: Mark was an awesome...
text: Mark was an awesome guide. It was clear he is really passionate about the Sagrada Família. He is super knowledgeable and will answer as many questions as you throw at him
author: Jacob_K

title: Great private tour of the Sagrada Familia
text: David is a very dedicated and competent guide. He guided us through the church with a lot of expertise.
author: Wolfgang_T

title: Lupe is amazing
text: Lupe was amazing: attentive, corteous and very knowledgeable. Her English was excellent and kept the information interesting. She gave us almost an extra hour.
author: Anonymous

title: Marc was an excellent...
text: Marc was an excellent guide! He was incredibly knowledgeable, informative, and engaging throughout our private tour of the Sagrada Família. He explained the history, architecture, and symbolism in a way that was fascinating and easy to understand. We learned so much and truly appreciated his expertise and enthusiasm. Marc made our visit to the Sagrada Família even more memorable. Highly recommend him!
author: Lisa_D

title: Marc knew every story and...
text: Marc knew every story and detail made the tour not boring at all.  He told us every symbols hidden and made us so amused with the history of Sagrada Familia itself.
author: natalia_k

title: Best Experience
text: Our guide was absolutely fabulous! We all got so much more out of the tour, thanks to our guide. He was very knowledgeable and customized our tour to meet our needs. He had a wealth of knowledge of Sagrada Familia. Well worth it and highly recommend!
author: Amy_S

title: Excellent tour and...
text: Excellent tour and wonderful guide. Susanna is the best. Great knowledge and spoke perfect English for us.
author: Mark_S
